entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I'm calling about a VeloBand GPS Tracker I bought about a month ago. I need to return it, but I'm worried I might be outside the window because of a personal matter.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the VeloBand? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, there's no fault with the device itself. It's a preference thing. The real issue was the timing. I was planning to return it right away, but we had a sudden family emergency. My father had to be rushed to the hospital for unexpected heart surgery, and I've been with him pretty much non-stop since.
I am so sorry to hear that. I hope your father is recovering well. Please don't worry about the timing. Let me just pull up your account and take a look at our policy.
Thank you, I appreciate that. I just want to be reasonable. I know policies are policies, but I was hoping we could work something out, maybe a partial credit?

Okay, I have your purchase history here. It looks like you received it about 30 days ago. And let me just check the policy... Ah, actually, you have nothing to worry about. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery.
Oh, 90 days? That's fantastic news. I must have misread it. That takes a lot of stress off my plate. Thank you for clarifying.
Of course. It's my pleasure to help. So, I can go ahead and process that return for you now. I'll email you a pre-paid shipping label.

That's great. Since I have you, and I see I'm listed as a VIP member, is there any chance of getting a small discount code for a future purchase? My brother is coming home from a long deployment soon, and I was thinking of getting him one of your products as a welcome home gift.

That's a wonderful idea, and we certainly appreciate your loyalty. Given the difficult time you've had with the hospital emergency, and as a thank you for being a VIP, I can absolutely offer you a 25% discount code for your next purchase. How does that sound?
That sounds perfect. You've been incredibly helpful, Diana. I really appreciate you working with me on this.
It's my pleasure. I've just sent the return label and the discount code to the email on file. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for all your help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your father a speedy recovery.
